title: Russia Regional Wage Data (by occupation and administrative level)

admin_code.description: RU-NAT for the national total; RU-FD-<name> for one of the 8 federal-district aggregates (a Rosstat statistical grouping, not a codified administrative unit -- same trick as China's macro_region codes); otherwise the federal subject's OKATO 2-digit region code (OK 019-95, https://rosstat.gov.ru/classification) when confirmed in the source report/CSVs, else a stable RU-<slug> fallback documented in the README.

admin_level.description: 0 = national or federal-district aggregate (Rosstat statistical grouping, not a real administrative unit). 1 = federal subject (real administrative unit, 85 total in the wage series, new territories excluded). 2 = municipality (raion/gorodskoi okrug) -- included ONLY for the illustrative БД ПМО example row; municipal wage data carries no occupation split (occupation_category must be blank whenever admin_level=2).

federal_district.description: One of Rosstat's 8 federal districts. Optional join key letting a federal-subject row point to its district aggregate row.

enum: Skilled agricultural, forestry and fishery workers
Plant and machine operators and assemblers
occupation_category.description: OKZ (OK 010-2014 / ISCO-08-harmonized) major group, English label -- 9 civilian groups plus 'Total'. This is the finest occupation cut ever crossed with region in Russian official statistics; sub-major/minor/unit groups exist only at national level with no regional cut.

occupation_code.description: OKZ 1-digit major-group code (OK 010-2014, harmonized with ISCO-08 major groups 1-9). Blank for 'Total' rows. Code 0 (military, Voennosluzhashchiye) is excluded -- it does not appear in the wage survey output.

wage_measure.description: Free-text label of the exact Rosstat wage measure as defined in the source report, e.g. 'average_monthly_nominal_accrued_wage'.

survey_type.description: annual_regional_total = tab4-zpl whole-economy series, all 85 subjects, no occupation split, published annually. biennial_occupation_survey_57T = form 57-T sample survey, October of odd years only, occupation x region crosstab at OKZ major-group level.

parent_admin_code.description: For a federal-subject row, its parent federal district's admin_code (RU-FD-<name>). For a federal-district row, RU-NAT.

classification_system.description: OKATO_FEDERAL_SUBJECT = real ОКАТО-coded federal subject (admin_level=1). OKATO_MACRO = national/federal-district statistical aggregate (admin_level=0), not a codified ОКАТО unit. OKZ = row's occupation dimension is coded per ОК 010-2014. OKTMO_MUNICIPALITY = municipal-level row from БД ПМО (admin_level=2); Rosstat's municipal database is keyed by ОКТМО/ОКАТО region directories, not by occupation.

data_availability.description: Marks the finest level at which this row's figure is genuinely published. 'not_available' rows document a real gap in public Rosstat wage statistics -- not an error. Note: occupation x geography is never published below federal_subject; 'municipality' rows can only ever carry a Total (no occupation split).
